note: Theme illustrations only. Prompts contain no puzzle solutions or unpublished hints.

covers.scene: A lonely lighthouse on a rocky island at night, a warm lantern and a cute small green turtle detective in the foreground, moonlight over gentle waves.
An empty cozy vintage cafe bar, a sparkling glass of water on the wooden counter, warm amber pendant lamps, an intriguing closed door in the background. No weapons.
A whimsical blue night train at a quiet railway platform, an old station clock and a small green turtle detective carrying a suitcase, purple sunset sky.
An empty cheerful classroom, two wooden desks near a sunlit window, notebooks and a pencil, spring leaves outside, intriguing gentle mystery atmosphere.
A mysterious blue suburban house at night with one warmly glowing window, crescent moon, a small green turtle detective holding a flashlight outside. Playful, not frightening.
A pink birthday cake with one glowing candle on a cozy wooden table, confetti, an envelope and a tiny green turtle detective, warm peach and yellow colors.
A friendly golden dog with a red ball beside a small green turtle detective in a bright garden, expressive faces, lush blue and green landscape.
A small wooden boat near a beautiful deserted tropical island, blue sea, a rolled map and brass compass in the foreground, a small green turtle detective observing the horizon.
A small blue family car parked safely on an empty road under a starry night sky, warm cabin light, a cute green turtle detective inspecting a road map. No accident, no baby, no distress.
A beautiful pair of red high heels on a wooden backstage dressing table, golden vanity bulbs, purple curtains, small green turtle detective watching curiously. No person, no danger.
A half-full crystal perfume bottle with a pink ribbon on a bedroom vanity, softly lit blue curtains, warm lamp, cute green turtle detective looking thoughtfully. No hidden person.
A cozy writers attic with an open skylight showing a blue spring sky, loose manuscript pages and a typewriter on a desk, small green turtle detective, sunbeams and warm colors.
A magical but ordinary cozy public library with tall bookshelves, an open blank book on a wooden reading table, green turtle detective wearing little glasses. No readable text.
An ornate vintage wooden music box with its lid open, tiny musical notes floating as decorative sparkles, lavender childhood bedroom, small green turtle detective. No secret mechanism.
Two brightly colored ice cream cones in a cheerful ice cream shop, mint green and pastel pink scoops, a friendly green turtle detective, sunny afternoon. No tragedy.
A blue compact car beside a cheerful urban parking entrance with a few stone steps and a street lamp, cute green turtle detective holding a key. No text or numbers.
